_note: Architecture disclosures appended to projection_note for services whose GCP target or topology cannot be determined from a CUR. Recovered from the former confidence-caps.json when the confidence subsystem was removed — these NOTES were never about confidence, they travelled with it.

disclosures.label: OpenSearch compute
disclosures.note: architecture review recommended: multiple valid GCP targets exist (Managed OpenSearch via Marketplace, Elastic Cloud, Vertex AI Search, or self-managed GCE); self-managed GCE assumed — verify migration strategy with customer

disclosures.label: MSK/Kafka
disclosures.note: architecture review recommended: MSK modeled as VM-only; replication factor, broker topology, and managed storage scaling are not captured by CUR and require separate assessment

disclosures.label: RDS/Aurora
disclosures.note: CUR does not reveal HA intent beyond Multi-AZ flag, storage latency requirements, connection limits, or read replica topology; verify Cloud SQL tier and HA config with customer

disclosures.label: ElastiCache
disclosures.note: ElastiCache cluster topology and multi-AZ failover not fully captured by CUR; verify Memorystore tier selection
